name: Sluff Off
summary: Trick-taking game where players predict trick colors, take tokens to discard, and try to sluff off without picking up penalties.
rules_text: Each round each player is dealt 15 cards from 5 suits (blue is trump). In prediction order, each player either takes colored tokens from the center matching the color and number of tricks they expect to win, or takes the Sluffer piece (only one per round). If a wanted color is gone, steal it from another player who gets a white wild token. Then 15 tricks are played clockwise; leader plays any card, others must follow suit if possible, otherwise may sluff any card including trump. Highest card of led suit wins unless a blue is played, then highest blue wins. Winner discards a token of the led color or blue if trumped, white acts as wild. If they have no matching token, they take a black -3 penalty token; Sluffer never takes tokens. After all tricks, 0 tokens = 0 points, each remaining colored token = 2 penalty, black = 3, white = 4. Sluffer gets -4 plus -1 per black given to others. Play as many rounds as players; lowest total penalty wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking card game with hidden hands, sequential choice, clear bluffing strategy.
